Assume the Axiom of Choice. Let $X$ be a real or complex normed space. For a subspace $M\subseteq X$ and $x\in X$,

$$\operatorname{dist}(x,\overline M)=\sup\{|f(x)|:f\in M^\perp,\ \|f\|\le1\}.$$
